findings.claim: With no --scope, it applies the recorded scope and prints SCOPED: <name> -- … before the scope's own verdict line.
classify_declared carries a gate's SCOPED: line into its row note, on both PASS and FAIL. Only the scope name is carried, because mark() keeps 200 chars of a note and a red row's reason must survive.

lanes.summary:
Lane 2 of 3 review for ticket GH-4086 (branch fix/4086-dogfood-ladder-scope-seam against origin/chore/0.69.1-merge-back). Attempted refutation against all criteria and found nothing to refute:

1. Defect & Ticket Alignment:
   At 0.69.1, release gates passed check_model_ladder.sh --scope crux-smoke while dogfood executed check_model_ladder.sh with no arguments (defaulting to the full ladder) and went RED. The diff resolves this by having check_model_ladder.sh look up any emergency scope recorded for the release version when --scope is omitted, while providing MODEL_LADDER_CRUX_DIR as an environment seam for dogfood, printing 'SCOPED: <name>', allowing '--scope none' to force the full ladder, and ensuring dogfood row notes carry the scope name on both PASS and FAIL.

2. Gate Strength & Failure Modes:
   No gate is weakened. If no emergency scope is recorded for the version (e.g. 0.70.0), the full ladder is judged. If multiple scopes or a nameless scope are recorded, the gate fails closed (RED) without judging either the scope or ladder. If receipts are not from the binary being cut, it fails closed (measured: rc 1 'not the release binary' on HEAD vs rc 0 when cut-commit matches published receipts).

3. Receipt Claims Verified (all measured):
   - bash scripts/check_model_ladder.sh --self-test: rc 0, '147 case(s), 0 bad' (select table 6 rows + 4 mutants killed; e2e table 7 rows + 4 mutants killed; must-RED row confirmed).
   - bash scripts/check_dogfood_no_defer.sh --self-test: rc 0 (4 new declnote rows + 3 mutants killed).
   - Real data 0.69.1 receipts with --cut-commit d8a6df53a...3f: rc 0 ('SCOPED: crux-smoke -- satisfied').
   - Real data 0.69.1 receipts at HEAD: rc 1 ('not the release binary').
   - pv validate contracts/model-capability-ladder-v1.yaml: valid (0 error, 0 warning).
   - check_dogfood_shim.sh, check_no_claim_literals.sh, check_dogfood_no_defer.sh: all rc 0.
   - bashrs lint --no-ignore --level error: 0 errors, 0 warnings across all 3 changed shell files.
   - Pre-push gates: cargo fmt --all -- --check rc 0; cargo test -p aprender-contracts --lib (1701 passed); cargo deny check advisories (ok).

4. Scope & Hygiene:
   Diff contains only the requested functionality and tests. No extra files or unrelated changes. Verdict: PASS.
